historicalCompilationContext.scope: Journal workload, including overlapping selections and interrupted runs; not unique suite coverage. Execution wall time is unavailable in historical journals. withinBatchElapsedDeltaMs is an approximation excluding each first launch and including preparation skew. Whole-suite projections include compilation only at observed batch occupancy.

projection: Compilation-only historical extrapolation is 143.478 h for managed-template journals at observed batch occupancy, with overlap and interrupted work retained. No end-to-end suite-hours prediction or Node-hosted compile saving is attributed to generated-code improvements.
